messages.S3を捨てて「探求した知識」を3にし、コインを再使用するS1「知識消耗」を主力に: A Slash attacker that discards S3 to reach 3 Insight, then relies on Coin reuse from S1 Expend Knowledge. Maintaining 3 Insight requires managing which discardable skills remain in his slots.
messages.探求した知識: 最後に捨てたスキルのランク(基本値1)。S3を捨てれば3、S2な: **Insight**: The rank of the last discarded skill (default 1). Discarding S3 makes it 3, S2 makes it 2, and S1 makes it 1.
messages.S1「知識消耗」: 使用時にスロット内でランクが最も高いスキル1つを捨てる。スロ: **S1 — Expend Knowledge**: On use, discards the highest-rank skill in his slots. If there is no S3 in his slots but there is an S2, it discards S2, dropping Insight to 2. At 3 or more Insight, it reuses Coin Ⅰ and gains Clash Power (at Uptie Ⅳ, it reuses (Insight − 1) times and gains +(Insight − 1) Clash Power; at 3 Insight, 2 reuses and +2). Reuse happens when attacking, so the Clash uses 1 Coin.
messages.S2「開け放つ」・守備「導く歩み」: ランダムな2つのスキルをランクの低い順に捨: **S2 Unveil and the Defense skill Guiding Steps**: Discard 2 random skills in ascending order of rank. The rank of the last one discarded becomes Insight, so discarding only S1s drops it to 1. S2 gains Coin Power at 3 or more Insight (+(Insight − 1) at Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.S3「循環する知識」: 知識2以上なら知識の値だけコイン威力が上がり、対象の沈潜: **S3 — Cyclical Knowledge**: At 2 or more Insight, gains Coin Power equal to Insight and deals more damage based on the target's Sinking. It does not discard other skills itself.
messages.バトルパッシブ「鍵を覗き込む」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分がスキル: **Combat passive — Peering Through a Key (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When he discards a skill, gains Damage Up equal to its rank, up to 3 per turn. When an ally discards a skill of higher rank than his Insight, his Insight increases by 1.
messages.スロットにS3がある状態でS1(またはS2)を使い、S3を捨てて知識を3にする。: Use S1 (or S2) while S3 is in his slots to discard S3 and bring Insight to 3. After that, each use of S1 or S2 discards the remaining skills, and Insight drops if S2 or S1 is discarded last. Once Insight is 3, he can keep it there by replacing the lower-row skills with Defense skills and using only the upper row, leaving no discardable skills (Defense skills cannot be discarded). He also inflicts Sinking, but his core is sustained Slash damage.
